simple.meaning: Casluchim , a people cognate to the Egyptians
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כַּסְלֻחִים (H3695) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: כַּסְלֻחִים (Kaçluchîym) means Casluchim , a people cognate to the Egyptians First listed occurrence: 1Chr 1 12.

definitions.short: Casluchim , a people cognate to the Egyptians
definitions.full: H3695. Kasluchim כַּסְלֻחִים proper name, of a people Gen 10:14 ( ᵐ5 D Ξασμωνιειμ , ᵐ5 L Ξασλωνιειμ E Ξαλοειμ ) = 1Chr 1:12 (A Ξασλωνιειμ , ᵐ5 L Ξασλωειμ ), among the sons of מִָצְרַיִם not identified; conjectures in Thes Di. תָּבוֺר כִּסְלֹת see כְּסֻלּוֺת above
definitions.rootNote: a plural probably of foreign derivation;
